name: Animated Combobox
summary: Animated React combobox with a morphing portal, grouped filtering, keyboard navigation and controlled or uncontrolled state.
description: A composable React combobox that pairs a searchable input with a filtered, portalled listbox while keeping focus in the input. Parts cover trigger, input, list, group, item, label, separator, empty state and value; props cover open, query, value and a custom filter, all controlled or uncontrolled. Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/combobox) or copy the TSX source; the page includes the API reference and the shared ease and utils files.
contains: composable parts: trigger, input, list, group, item, label, separator, empty, value
searchable input with grouped filtering and keyboard navigation; portalled listbox
controlled or uncontrolled value, open and query state
install: bunx --bun shadcn add @beui/combobox, or copy the source
shared files: lib/utils.ts, lib/ease.ts and combobox internals (content, context, list, trigger)
